name: STD Testing
title: Private STD Testing in Tustin | OC Concierge Doctor
description: Comprehensive, private STD testing in Tustin with Tariq A. Khan, MD. Chlamydia, gonorrhea, syphilis, HIV, and more, with an exam and treatment from your doctor.
lede: Many sexually transmitted infections cause no symptoms for months or years, and you can pass one on without knowing it. Dr. Khan offers comprehensive testing and treatment in a private office setting.
glance: Comprehensive testing with an exam, results, and treatment from the same doctor.
facts: Doctor's office, not a clinic line

signs.heading: Get tested if you notice
signs.intro: Symptoms can be mild, come and go, or look like something else. Testing is the only way to know.
items: Discharge from the vagina or penis
Itching, pain, or swelling in the genitals or anus
Sores or bumps on the genitals, thighs, or buttocks
Flu-like symptoms such as fever, aches, or fatigue
A new partner, or a partner who tested positive

basics.heading: Why testing matters
paras: STDs spread through all types of sexual activity. Chlamydia, gonorrhea, and syphilis have been rising for years, and untreated infections can cause lasting harm.

Untreated syphilis, for example, can stay dormant and later cause serious complications, can be passed to a baby during pregnancy, and makes it easier to transmit or acquire HIV. Most STDs are treatable, and many are curable, once you know.

steps.heading: What to expect
items: Dr. Khan checks for sores, warts, rashes, and discharge, and asks about symptoms and risk.
Blood, urine, a cheek swab, or a swab of a sore, depending on what he is checking for.
